title: 1.1.21 Does It Fit?
description: Judge whether a prescriptive model fits a startup with changing requirements, with a reason. AI-graded with hints.

aiGrader.prompt:
Everything you need is in 1.1.19 (Prescriptive Process Models) and 1.1.20 (Where Prescriptive Models Break) — go back and reread them if you get stuck. Two or three sentences is plenty, in your own everyday words.

Zara runs a startup. Her product requirements change every week as she talks to new customers. A prescriptive process model asks a team to follow an orderly, planned-out sequence of activities.

1. Would a prescriptive process model fit Zara's project? Give a clear yes or no. (1.1.19)

2. Why? Explain your answer in terms of how rigid that model is against requirements that keep changing. (1.1.20)

rubric.title: Clear answer that it does not fit
rubric.description: Student clearly answers 'no' (or an equivalent like 'poor fit' or 'not a good fit'). Full credit for an unambiguous no. Deny if the answer is 'yes', 'maybe', or too vague to tell.

rubric.title: Reason references rigidity against changing requirements
rubric.description: Student's stated reason references the rigidity/inflexibility of prescriptive models against rapidly changing requirements — not a generic or unrelated justification. Full credit for a reason tied to the model being inflexible when requirements change weekly. Deny for a bare 'no' with no reason, or a reason that does not mention inflexibility vs. changing requirements.
